title: Basic Melee Combat & Auto-Attack
description: Engage a solitary, low-level hostile NPC using standard melee weapon strikes and auto-attacks.
instructions: Locate a solitary hostile mob (e.g. low-level wolf or bandit) in an open area.
Stand at ~15m range with weapon drawn.
Open chat and start trace: `/trace start combat_basic_melee`
Target the hostile unit by clicking or pressing Tab.
Approach into melee range and initiate basic attack / auto-attack.
Allow the attack sequence to land and observe damage numbers.
Defeat the enemy and wait 2 seconds for death animation and loot generation.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`
Click 'Run Coverage Analysis' to verify packet capture.

checklist.text: Acquire target lock on hostile mob
Execute melee attack and record damage packet
Wait for mob defeat / death state

notes: Verified human trace in corpus (6,775 records, 49.7s). Captured CSChangeTargetPacket, CSStartSkillPacket, SCCombatFirstHitPacket, SCSkillFiredPacket, and SCUnitDeathPacket.

title: Basic Ranged Combat & Arrow Skills
description: Engage hostile mob at range with bow / projectile skills.
instructions: Target hostile mob at range
Fire ranged skills via CSStartSkillPacket
Verify SCUnitDamagedPacket and SCUnitDeathPacket

checklist.text: Fire projectile attacks and confirm hit

notes: Verified human trace in corpus (5,302 records, 40.5s). Captured 20x CSStartSkillPacket, SCUnitDamagedPacket, SCUnitDeathPacket.

title: Quest Dialogue, Objective & Turn-In
description: Interact with a quest-giving NPC, accept an introductory quest, fulfill the objective, and turn it in for rewards.
instructions: Find an NPC with an available quest exclamation mark (!).
Start trace: `/trace start quest_accept_and_turnin`
Interact with the NPC (`F` key) to open dialogue window.
Select and accept the quest via the dialogue menu.
Navigate to the required objective location.
Complete the required action (kill mob, pick item, or interact with doodad).
Return to the quest NPC and turn in the quest (`?` mark).
Collect quest experience and item reward.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`

checklist.text: Interact with NPC and accept quest
Turn in quest and accept reward

notes: Verified human trace in corpus (22,631 records, 137s). Captured full quest lifecycle: accept (CSStartQuestContextPacket), objective progression (12x SCQuestContextUpdatedPacket), and turn-in reward (CSCompleteQuestContextPacket).

title: Workbench Crafting & Production
description: Approach an artisan workbench (e.g. carpentry or weaving), select a single recipe, and craft it using materials and labor.
instructions: Ensure character has required raw materials and labor points.
Stand directly in front of an active crafting workstation.
Start trace: `/trace start craft_single_item`
Interact with the workbench to open the production interface.
Select an affordable single-craft recipe.
Click Craft / Produce and allow the progress bar to finish.
Verify product item appears in inventory and labor power is deducted.
Close workstation interface.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`

checklist.text: Trigger craft action and await completion

title: Use Bag Consumable Item
description: Activate a consumable item (e.g. bread, health potion, or buff scroll) directly from the player bag.
instructions: Open inventory bag (`I` key) and locate a food or potion item.
Start trace: `/trace start use_bag_consumable`
Right-click the consumable item to activate it.
Observe health/mana point recovery or buff application.
Wait for the item cooldown timer to appear.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`

checklist.text: Verify cooldown packet and stat recovery

notes: Verified human trace in corpus (1,192 records, 8.4s). Confirms item use triggers CSStartSkillPacket with item skill ID.

title: Direct Player-to-Player Trade
description: Initiate bilateral player trade, place an item or gold in the trade window, lock trade, and complete trade.
instructions: Stand facing another player character.
Start trace: `/trace start trade_direct_player`
Target player, right-click frame and select Trade.
Wait for other player to accept trade invitation.
Drag an item or enter 1 silver into the trade window.
Click 'Lock Trade'.
When both players lock, click 'Trade / Accept'.
Verify trade window closes and item transfers.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`

checklist.text: Send trade request and open trade frame
Place item or coin in trade slot

title: Equipment Repair at Blacksmith
description: Approach a blacksmith or weapon merchant NPC, open the repair interface, and repair a damaged piece of gear.
instructions: Ensure at least one equipped item has slight durability loss.
Approach a Blacksmith NPC.
Start trace: `/trace start equipment_repair`
Talk to Blacksmith and select the Repair option (anvil icon).
Click 'Repair All' or click the specific item.
Confirm money deduction.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`

checklist.text: Confirm repair and verify durability restoration

title: Warehouse Deposit & Withdrawal
description: Open personal bank storage at a Warehouse Manager NPC, deposit an item, and withdraw it back.
instructions: Locate a Warehouse Manager NPC in a town.
Start trace: `/trace start warehouse_banking`
Interact with NPC to open the Warehouse window.
Right-click an item in bag to deposit into warehouse slot.
Right-click the item in warehouse slot to withdraw back to bag.
Close warehouse window.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`

title: Mailbox Send & Receive
description: Interact with a world mailbox doodad, compose an in-game mail to an alt or friend, and collect returned mail.
instructions: Find a world Mailbox doodad (owl post).
Start trace: `/trace start mail_send_receive`
Interact with mailbox (`F` key).
Click Compose Mail, type recipient name and message body.
Attach 1 silver coin and click Send.
Close mailbox window.
Stop trace: `/trace stop`

title: Two Potatoes Full Cycle (Plant x2, Wait, Harvest x2)
description: Architecture probe trace: approach soil, STOP, plant potato 1, sidestep, STOP, plant potato 2, wait on camera, harvest both. Establishes U1 stop/range/facing and U2 plant/harvest paths.
instructions: Stand clear of the farm plot with 2+ potato seeds (item 15659) and labor available.
Execute `/trace start two_potatoes_full_cycle` in chat.
Approach the first soil spot, release all movement keys, and hold fully still for 2 seconds (no input).
Place potato seed 1. Execute `/mark planted_1` in chat.
Sidestep to an adjacent soil spot, release keys, hold fully still for 2 seconds.
Place potato seed 2. Execute `/mark planted_2` in chat.
Wait WITHOUT leaving the plot (captures growth phases and maturity duration).
Approach crop 1, stop fully, harvest it. Execute `/mark harvested_1` in chat.
Approach crop 2, stop fully, harvest it. Execute `/mark harvested_2` in chat.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.

checklist.text: 2s full stop before plant 1 (no movement input)

notes: Phase-0 flagship. U1: stop+range from move_stop/doodad_created geometry; facing TBD (no yaw-at-action hook yet). U2: plant=CSCreateDoodad sync, harvest=Skill.Use 13980/4000ms.

title: Crop Growth to Maturity (World-Condition Wait)
description: Plant one potato and remain on camera until it matures, capturing growth phase transitions and maturity duration for world-condition defer evidence.
instructions: Stand at a farm plot with 1 potato seed and labor available.
Execute `/trace start farm_growth_to_maturity` in chat.
Stop fully, place the potato seed. Execute `/mark planted` in chat.
Remain within sight of the crop without interacting (AFK-watch, keep client active).
When the crop reaches mature phase, execute `/mark mature` in chat.
Stop trace: `/trace stop` (do NOT harvest — harvest belongs to two_potatoes_full_cycle).
notes: Only trace source for maturity duration; gates world-condition DeferUntil. No growth phases captured in any prior trace.

title: NPC Single Line-Item Purchase (Position-Disciplined)
description: Approach a merchant, STOP, open dialog, buy exactly one line item. Gives Buy range/settle evidence and pre-convergence baseline for the second validation family.
instructions: Bring sufficient coin for one cheap line item (e.g. chick). Note your distance to the merchant.
Execute `/trace start npc_buy_single` in chat.
Approach the merchant, release all keys, hold fully still for 2 seconds.
Open dialog (single CSStartInteractionPacket), then interact.
Buy exactly ONE line item, one unit. Execute `/mark bought` in chat.
Hold still 2 seconds, then execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Second-family gate. Current actor Buy is non-atomic parallel logic; this trace is the convergence oracle (packet atomic rollback vs actor grant-then-charge).

title: NPC Single-Item Sale + Buyback Window
description: Sell one item to a merchant and observe the buyback-window traffic, complementing npc_buy_single for the sell path.
instructions: Bring one low-value bag item to sell.
Execute `/trace start npc_sell_single` in chat.
Approach the merchant, hold fully still for 2 seconds.
Open dialog, then interact.
Sell exactly ONE item. Execute `/mark sold` in chat.
Observe the buyback window, hold still 2 seconds.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Pairs with npc_buy_single; prior sell trace showed SCSoldItemList buyback traffic worth capturing deliberately.

title: Horse Mount via Item Skill Cast
description: Mount a horse via the item-skill cast path, capturing the instant-cast item skill and mount packet sequence.
instructions: Stand still with a mount item/skill available.
Execute `/trace start mount_horse_itemcast` in chat.
Activate the mount (item skill 10602 or equivalent).
Wait for mount state to settle (2 seconds, no input).
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Prior mount traces are packet-envelope-only (zero mount_mate semantic events); sets baseline for item-cast family.

title: Observer-Capture Plant (Two-Connection U3 Probe)
description: U3 apparatus probe: second account stands 5m away while the planter plants. Requires two-connection observer capture support; run only after the trace service records observer streams.
instructions: REQUIRES observer-stream capture support in PlayerTraceService.
Park observer account ~5m from the farm plot, facing it.
Start trace on the OBSERVER account: `/trace start observer_capture_plant`
Planter account (untraced) plants one potato.
Hold 3 seconds, then `/trace stop` on the observer.

checklist.text: Remote plant observed (skill/doodad packets on observer conn)

notes: U3 work item, NOT a correctness gate. Expected to FAIL evaluation until observer-stream capture lands — that failure is the apparatus signal.

title: Single Potato Plant (Stop-Disciplined)
description: Stop fully, plant one potato seed, observe placement. Standalone U1 range/stop gate for the plant half of Two-Potatoes.
instructions: Stand clear of a farm plot with 1 potato seed (item 15659) and labor available.
Execute `/trace start plant_single_potato` in chat.
Approach the soil spot, release all keys, hold fully still for 2 seconds.
Place the potato seed. Execute `/mark planted` in chat.
Hold still 2 seconds, then execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: No skill cast expected on plant path (CSCreateDoodad sync). Pairs with harvest_single_crop.

title: Single Mature Crop Harvest (Stop-Disciplined)
description: Stop fully, harvest one mature potato crop through the real 4000ms skill-cast path. Core U2 harvest evidence.
instructions: Locate a MATURE potato crop (phase 4457).
Execute `/trace start harvest_single_crop` in chat.
Approach the crop, release all keys, hold fully still for 2 seconds.
Target the crop and harvest (skill 13980, ~4000ms cast). Execute `/mark harvested` in chat.
Hold still 2 seconds, then execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Expect request>fire ~4060ms. Completion triple: SCSkillFired + doodad_use + phase change.

title: Crop Watering Skill Cast
description: Cast the water skill (13625, 1500ms) on a growing crop. Captures a short-cast farm skill for cast-timing comparison.
instructions: Locate a growing (non-mature) crop.
Execute `/trace start water_crop_skill` in chat.
Stop fully, target the crop, cast the water skill.
Wait for the fired packet, hold 2 seconds.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Short-cast comparator for harvest 4000ms timing.

title: Wild Resource Gathering (Herb/Ore/Lumber)
description: Gather one wild resource node (herb, ore, or lumber) with full stop discipline. Tests whether wild gather shares the farm skill-cast shape.
instructions: Locate an ungathered wild resource node.
Execute `/trace start gather_wild_resource` in chat.
Approach, release keys, hold fully still for 2 seconds.
Gather the node with the appropriate tool skill. Execute `/mark gathered` in chat.
Hold still 2 seconds, then execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: If gather turns out F-key (non-skill) driven, this task FAILs packet assertion by design — that failure IS the finding; report node type in notes.

title: Mob Corpse Loot
description: Kill or find a lootable corpse, open the loot bag, and take an item. Covers the missing loot family.
instructions: Locate a corpse with loot (kill a mob if needed, off-trace).
Execute `/trace start loot_mob_corpse` in chat.
Approach the corpse, hold still 2 seconds.
Open the loot bag and take one item. Execute `/mark looted` in chat.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: No distance gate expected in packet handler (verify: loot-at-range behavior decides actor loot discipline).

title: NPC Dialogue Open (No Purchase)
description: Open an NPC dialog and close it with no transaction. Isolates the dialog transport (StartInteraction/InteractNPC) from Buy/Sell semantics.
instructions: Approach any service NPC.
Execute `/trace start npc_talk_dialogue` in chat.
Hold still 2 seconds, open dialog, wait for the option list.
Close dialog with no transaction. Execute `/mark talked` in chat.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.

checklist.text: Closed with no transaction + marked talked

notes: No distance gate in CSStartInteractionPacket (TODO in handler) — do NOT invent talk-range discipline from this trace.

title: Livestock Place & Harvest (Chick Coop)
description: Place a chick coop and harvest it (6500ms skill 13967). Animal-husbandry counterpart to crop farm evidence.
instructions: Bring a chick item with coop space available.
Execute `/trace start livestock_place_harvest` in chat.
Stop fully, place the chick. Execute `/mark placed` in chat.
Harvest the coop (skill 13967, ~6500ms). Execute `/mark harvested` in chat.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Prior traces show phase chain 5794>5801>8434 with labor -10; re-capture deliberately.

title: Trade Pack Pickup (RecoverItem Path)
description: Pick up a world trade/material pack via the RecoverItem path. First hauler-loop evidence.
instructions: Locate a placed trade/material pack.
Execute `/trace start trade_pack_pickup` in chat.
Approach, hold still 2 seconds, pick up the pack. Execute `/mark picked` in chat.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Handler comment confirms RecoverItem pickup shares the loot-bag path; delivery/turn-in is a separate future task.

title: Auction Search & Single Listing
description: Search the auction house and post one single-item listing. Covers the missing auction family transport.
instructions: Bring one sellable item plus listing fee to an Auction House.
Execute `/trace start auction_search_and_post` in chat.
Search for the item's category. Execute `/mark searched` in chat.
Post ONE single-item listing. Execute `/mark posted` in chat.
Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Cancel/buyout flows are separate future tasks.

title: Pet Summon & Dismiss (Item Skill)
description: Summon a pet via item skill 10602 instant cast, then dismiss it. Completes the mount/pet item-cast pair.
instructions: Have a pet summon item ready, standing still.
Execute `/trace start pet_summon_dismiss` in chat.
Summon the pet, wait 2 seconds. Execute `/mark summoned` in chat.
Dismiss the pet, wait 2 seconds. Execute `/trace stop` in chat.
notes: Prior traces show no spawn/despawn world events — capture confirms whether that gap persists.

title: Out-of-Combat Food & Potion Resource Recovery
description: Engage hostile mobs until Health or Mana falls below 50%, disengage/defeat enemy, and consume food (bread/soup) or potion items to recover resources while out of combat.
instructions: Engage hostile mobs until character Health or Mana drops below 50%.
Defeat or disengage from enemy to drop combat state.
Start trace: /trace start combat_food_potion_recovery in chat.
Open inventory bag ('I' key) and right-click food or health/mana potion.
Observe resource bar regeneration tick and buff application.
Wait 5 seconds for healing effect or stat tick.
Stop trace: /trace stop in chat.

checklist.text: Execute /trace start combat_food_potion_recovery out of combat with HP/MP < 50%
Right-click food consumable or potion from inventory

notes: Ground truth trace for PlayerBot sustain loop. Empirically verifies item-to-skill spell triggering and out-of-combat regeneration curve.

title: Combat Whirlwind / Knockback & Ranged Attack Switch
description: Engage an enemy mob featuring crowd control or whirlwind/knockback skills. When knocked into the air or separated beyond melee range (>4m), switch to ranged attacks while gap closers are on cooldown.
instructions: Locate a hostile mob known to cast whirlwind or knockback abilities.
Start trace: /trace start combat_knockback_ranged_fallback in chat.
Engage mob in melee combat and trigger its special whirlwind/knockback skill.
When thrown into air or pushed >4m away, fire ranged projectile skills (e.g. Endless Arrows, Shoot, or Charged Bolt).
Re-engage with gap closer (Charge/Overwhelm) when off cooldown or mob closes distance.
Defeat mob and stop trace: /trace stop.

checklist.text: Engage mob in melee and receive whirlwind / knockback displacement
Fire ranged weapon skill from >4m distance
Re-engage or finish mob in melee

notes: Captures distance separation handling and transition from melee to ranged projectile fire when airborne or displaced.

title: Mount Summon, Ride to Waypoint & Dismount Loop
description: Summon mount companion from bag or skill bar (Skill 10602 Summon Horse), mount up, travel along road to target destination, and dismount upon arrival.
instructions: Identify a destination or quest hub 100m+ away along a road.
Start trace: /trace start travel_mount_and_ride in chat.
Summon mount companion using whistle or summon skill (10602).
Board mount using interaction key ('F').
Ride along road towards waypoint.
Dismount upon reaching destination.
Stop trace: /trace stop in chat.
notes: Establishes canonical mounted travel sequence, velocity changes, and mount dismount protocol for bot travel routines.

title: Autonomous Quest Multi-Objective Progression
description: Accept a quest with multi-stage criteria (e.g. eliminate hostile mob and collect drop or interact with world doodad), executing sequential objective resolution.
instructions: Find an NPC offering a quest with multiple sequential objectives.
Start trace: /trace start quest_multi_objective_progression in chat.
Accept quest via dialogue.
Fulfill objective 1 (kill required mobs or collect dropped items).
Fulfill objective 2 (interact with quest doodad, flag, or chest).
Return to quest giver and turn in completed quest.
Collect rewards and stop trace: /trace stop in chat.

checklist.text: Fulfill interaction or collection objective stage
Turn in quest and execute /trace stop

notes: Expands quest automation beyond single-step tasks into multi-objective state progression.

title: Multi-Bot Party Combat Assist & Combo Weaving
description: Coordinate multiple bots or player+bot in a party: assist primary target, maintain combat formation, and chain synergistic combos (e.g. Tank Stun -> Rogue Backstab -> Mage Nuke).
instructions: Form a party with another player or PlayerBot (/party invite).
Start trace: /trace start bot_party_combat_assist in chat.
Party leader engages hostile target.
Follower/party member acquires leader's target ('T' assist) and closes in.
Party members execute complementary combo attacks.
Defeat target mob.
Stop trace: /trace stop in chat.

checklist.text: Execute /trace start bot_party_combat_assist in a party

notes: Captures party combat assist flow and cross-character target acquisition for cooperative PlayerBot groups.

title: PlayerBot Server Reboot & Position Persistence
description: Verify bot state preservation across server reboot: spawn/command bot, record position and inventory, restart server, execute /bot restore, and verify coordinate and equipment integrity.
instructions: Spawn a bot at custom coordinates using /bot add or /bot here.
Inspect bot position and equipped gear.
Restart the game server.
Run /bot restore to awaken dormant bots.
Confirm bot appears at exact pre-restart coordinates with equipment intact.

checklist.text: Verify initial world position and gear
Verify coordinate retention and equipment persistence

notes: Verified by unit tests and PB-006 closure. Fixes roll/yaw SQL swap, equipment save directly to DB, and coordinate zero-wipe.
